words: We design buildings that are calm, durable and honest about what they are made of.
Every plan starts with where the sun falls.
Stone, timber, concrete, glass. Used well, they age beautifully.
We design for a hundred years, not a news cycle.
Tell us about the site and what you imagine
A family home cut into a lava field. Black concrete outside, pale timber within, and one long window framing the sea.
A single 180-metre hall of light for a collection of sculpture, lit only from above.
Stepped reading rooms climbing a hillside, each with its own garden.
Twenty-two floors with a garden every fourth level and windows that open.
